title: Nexus StrategyApplyRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/apply. Apply installs one already-approved snapshot as the strategy's running identity: the request names the approval by its content hash only, because the approval row is immutable and already carries the document, hash, pins and trajectory. The path `strategy_id` is authoritative; a hash approved for another strategy is refused rather than paired with this one.

approval_content_hash.description: Canonical content hash of the approval to apply, as the approve response reported it. The daemon recomputes the hash from the approval's frozen document before writing, so a hash whose bytes moved is refused instead of installed.
